name: iubenda
summary: Compliance platform for websites and apps: cookie consent banner with consent log, generated privacy, cookie and terms documents, and Google Consent Mode, priced per site by pageviews.
best_for: website owners and small businesses in the EU and elsewhere that want a cookie banner, consent records and generated privacy and cookie policies in one subscription
skip_if: you run many sites and do not qualify for agency pricing, you need a Shopify-only consent app, or your legal team writes and hosts its own policies
honest_knock: Prices are per site, and each plan has a pageview quota (25K, 50K or 150K a month) with €0.05 per 1,000 above it. Essentials allows one language and up to 20 policy clauses; multilingual sites start on Advanced at €19.99 a month. The free plan's limits are not on the pricing page. iubenda's own documents disagree on tax: the pricing page says prices exclude VAT, while the pricing FAQs say prices include VAT where applicable; the same FAQs give a 14-day money-back guarantee on purchases and renewals. If you stop paying, a paid privacy policy cannot stay in use, though a policy generated on Free stays free, and a downgrade to Essentials switches off the terms and conditions document, which only Advanced and Ultimate include.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials · per site per month billed yearly, excl
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-22 with a plain fetch of iubenda.com/en/pricing: Essentials, Advanced and Ultimate prices in euros and dollars, the 25K, 50K and 150K pageview quotas and the €0.05 per 1,000 extra pageviews unchanged; every plan now also lists iubenda MCP) (read 2026-10-09 on iubenda.com/en/pricing, browser render plus the page source for the monthly and USD figures; prices exclude VAT) All plans are priced per site per month; yearly billing saves 16%. Essentials is €4.99 billed yearly or €5.99 monthly ($5.99 / $6.99) for up to 25K pageviews, a standard privacy and cookie policy with up to 20 clauses, one language, partial branding removal and monthly site scans. Advanced, marked most popular, is €19.99 yearly or €21.99 monthly ($24.99 / $27.99) for up to 50K pageviews, complete legal documents with up to 30 clauses, all languages and geo-targeting. Ultimate is €79.99 yearly or €89.99 monthly ($99.99 / $119.99) for up to 150K pageviews, unlimited clauses, full branding removal, hourly scans, a mobile SDK, detailed analytics and consent recovery. Above the quota every plan pays €0.05 per 1,000 extra pageviews. Forms proof of consent and the newsletter opt-in booster are €5 a month per 1,000 consents. A free plan exists (its limits are not on the pricing page but in the help centre, see below), every paid plan can be tried for 14 days, and agency and enterprise plans are quoted separately. Accessibility plans are a separate product, from €6 per site a month for up to 10K pageviews. Re-read on 24 October 2026 with a plain fetch of the same page: all three plans, quotas, overage and consent-storage prices unchanged. The accessibility plans on that page are Lite at €6 a site a month on either billing ($7) for 10K pageviews, with extra pageviews at €6 per 10K up to a hard ceiling of 80K, and Standard at €50 yearly or €55 monthly ($60 / $65) for 150K pageviews and a ceiling of 1 million; a Custom tier is delivered by AccessiWay. Yearly billing saves 10% on accessibility against 16% on the compliance plans. The free plan's limits, missing from the pricing page, are in iubenda's help article on the free plan (updated 25 August 2026): up to 5,000 pageviews a month, up to 3 third parties or clauses in the policy, one language, no terms and conditions and full iubenda branding.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested iubenda on the Free plan of an account we created, with a made-up site. After the site scan a plan window offered the Free plan or Advanced, and the Free plan went on without a card. A privacy policy was generated and a cookie banner previewed; the free banner shows the label Created with iubenda, and GDPR stood on manual configuration with a warning for Denmark and Greece. Terms and Conditions need the paid Advanced plan. Upgrade was not clicked, so no payment page was seen; the public page lists Advanced at EUR 19.99 per site a month on yearly billing. Account and start: we created the account and confirmed the e-mail address; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026; the start time was not recorded and the session ended at about 10:20 CET. The interface was in English. No phone number was asked anywhere. The dossier name is iubenda and the review is on AIBM (b2b/iubenda-review). Core action, a privacy policy and a cookie banner for one site: the made-up site test-shop-example.com was added. The scan gave 0%, Passed 0, Attention required 0, Needs your input 19 and Not applicable 3, with Proceed with assisted configuration. After the scan the window Choose a plan showed the Free plan at 89% (Limited configuration, missing Terms and Conditions and Premium Features) and the Advanced plan at 100% with Upgrade to Advanced and a 14 days money-back guarantee; Continue without recommended features kept the Free plan, and no card was asked. The site console showed FREE, an Upgrade button, Languages EN (US) and the checklist Step 1 Activate (0/3), Step 2 Configure and Step 3 Embed; Activate Terms & Conditions said the current plan does not include it. The privacy policy generator was run with a made-up owner and the services Contact form, Google Analytics 4 and Mailing list, and a policy was generated; it was not activated or embedded. The cookie solution was set up with GDPR, LGPD, Switzerland and US State Laws on. The preview on desktop, tablet and mobile showed a black banner with Learn more and customize, Reject and Accept and the label Created with iubenda. GDPR and LGPD stood on Manual configuration, and GDPR said Not configured according to the requirements of Denmark, Greece. Format and position, Text, Theme and the Privacy widget are options. The banner was not saved and not embedded anywhere. Plans: On iubenda.com/en/pricing, per site per month when billed yearly: Essentials EUR 4.99 (up to 25K pageviews, Standard Privacy & Cookie Policy, Mild branding capability), Advanced EUR 19.99 (Most popular, up to 50K pageviews, Complete legal documents, all available languages) and Ultimate EUR 79.99 (up to 150K pageviews, Advanced legal documents, Full branding capability, all available languages). In the app the plan window after the scan offers the Free plan (89%, Limited configuration, without Terms and Conditions and Premium Features) or the Advanced plan (100%, Monthly or Yearly, Save up to 10% with annual billing, 14 days money-back guarantee); no amounts are shown there. Checkout: no checkout was reached. Upgrade to Advanced was not clicked, so no payment page, card field, tax or total was seen; on the Free plan no card was asked at any point. Cancelling: Account, Account & Billing info, Subscription details offers payment information and cancellation options for each purchased plan; Manage opened Manage Subscriptions with only Payment Methods, so on the Free plan there is nothing to cancel. Account & Security has Delete your account, which was not clicked. Not tested: the consent database, the free pageview limit from the dossier, activating or embedding the policy or the banner, Terms and Conditions, other languages, a paid plan and cancelling it. Clean up: nothing was placed on a real site; the account and the made-up site stay on the Free plan. The own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free banner carries the label Created with iubenda. GDPR stays on manual configuration and warns that the setup does not meet the rules of Denmark and Greece until you change it. Terms and Conditions and the remaining 11% of the checklist need Advanced. The plan window inside the app shows no amounts, only the saving on yearly billing.
